app.name: WHATS POPPIN
app.tagline: All of Israel's pop-ups in one place

common.demoMode: Demo mode: sample data until Supabase is connected.

discover.title: What's on today?
discover.placeholderTitle: The feed is on its way!
discover.placeholderBody: Hot pop-ups, what's near you and what's on this weekend will show up here. Meanwhile, take a look at the design.
discover.nearbyEmptyBody: We checked up to 50 km around you. Pick another city or browse the whole country.
discover.sectionEmpty: Nothing here right now. Check back soon!

map.title: Map
map.noLocationBody: Turn on location or pick a city to see the closest pop-ups.
map.emptyBody: Try a larger distance or remove filters.
map.mapLabel: Pop-up map. The same information is available in the list below.
map.mapError: The map couldn't load. The list still works.

saved.emptyBody: Tap ♡ on any pop-up to save it here. We'll remind you before it ends.
saved.title: Saved
saved.intro: Your saved pop-ups, ending soonest first.
saved.pruned: {{count}} saved pop-ups ended and were removed.
saved.prunedOne: 1 saved pop-up ended and was removed.
saved.localNote: Saved items live in this browser. Sign in from Profile to see them on other devices.

profile.title: Profile
profile.placeholderBody: Pick favorite categories, your home area, notifications, and submit a pop-up for your business.
profile.guestBody: You can browse and save pop-ups without signing up. Signing in keeps everything on your other devices too.
profile.favoriteCategoriesHint: We'll use this to show you what interests you first.
profile.businessBody: Running a pop-up? Submit it for free and reach thousands of people nearby.

health.notConfigured: Supabase isn't connected yet. See README, step A.

errors.genericBody: It's not you, it's us. Please try again in a moment.
errors.offlineBody: Check your connection and try again.

preview.title: Design system
preview.sampleBody: Street food from young chefs, a DJ and local beer.
preview.intro: Every building block of the site in one place. The sample data here is fixed, not from the server.

meta.title: WHATS POPPIN – All of Israel's pop-ups
meta.description: Food, fashion, markets, art and brand pop-ups near you and across Israel. What's open now, what's on this weekend and what's ending soon.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The pop-up may have ended, or the link is wrong. Head back home to see what's on now.

location.promptTitle: Want to see what's near you?
location.promptBody: We only use your location to show distances and sort by what's close. We don't store it.
location.deniedBody: No problem! Pick a city and we'll show you what's on there.
location.sheetBody: We'll sort pop-ups by what's closest.

list.emptyBody: Nothing here right now. Check back soon, or browse the whole country.
list.needLocationTitle: We need a location to show what's near

search.title: Search
search.emptyBody: Try another word, a city or a category.
search.hint: What are you looking for? Search by name, city or category.

category.title: {{name}}
category.intro: Every pop-up in this category, nearest first.

details.remindLabel: Add a calendar reminder for the last day of {{title}}
details.endedBody: But there's plenty more. Here are other pop-ups in the same category.
details.pendingNote: Pending approval. Only you and admins can see this page.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: No passwords: we email you a code and you're in.
auth.why: Signing in keeps your saved pop-ups on every device and lets businesses submit pop-ups.
auth.codeSent: We emailed {{email}}. Click the link in the email, or type the code here.
auth.invalidEmail: Something's missing in the email address. Check and try again.
auth.invalidCode: The code is wrong or expired. You can request a new one.
auth.sendFailed: We couldn't send an email right now. Try again in a minute.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in will work once the site is connected to Supabase.
auth.callbackFailed: The link didn't work. This happens when it's opened in a different browser from the one you asked from, or when it was already used. Easiest: type the code from the email, or ask for a new one.
auth.spamHint: Can't see the email? Check your spam folder too.

business.title: For businesses
business.intro: Submit a pop-up, we approve it quickly, and it shows up for everyone nearby.
business.signInTitle: Sign in to submit a pop-up
business.signInBody: So you can edit your pop-ups and see how many people viewed, saved and navigated.
business.setupBody: Only the business name is required. You can fill in the rest later.
business.name: Business name
business.phone: Contact phone (not shown on the site)
business.empty: You haven't submitted any pop-ups yet. It takes about 3 minutes.
business.needsReview: Your changes will be reviewed soon. Meanwhile the pop-up stays live.
business.proTeaser: Coming soon: advanced stats and push to people nearby, on the business plan.
business.submitted: Thanks! Your pop-up was received and will appear after a quick approval.

form.title: Pop-up name
form.titleHint: Short and clear, like a sign.
form.short: One line shown on the card
form.addressHint: Street and number, or the venue name.
form.findAddress: Find the address on the map
form.notFound: We couldn't find that address. Try writing it differently or add the city.
form.mustFind: Find the address on the map before submitting.
form.addHours: Add different hours for other days
form.photosHint: The first photo appears on the card. Up to 6 photos.
form.datesInvalid: The end date must be after the start date.
form.errorTop: A few fields need fixing. They're marked in red.
form.uploadFailed: The photo couldn't be uploaded. Try another one.

admin.title: Admin
admin.notAdminTitle: This page is for site admins
admin.notAdminBody: If you're an admin, mark your account as admin in Supabase (see README).
admin.paymentNote: Payments will be connected later. For now, mark manually.

notifications.title: Reminders
notifications.body: We'll notify you a day before a saved pop-up ends, so you don't miss it.
notifications.failed: We couldn't turn on reminders. You can use “Calendar reminder” on any pop-up page.
notifications.iosInstall: On iPhone, reminders work after adding the site to your Home Screen: Share ⬆️ → “Add to Home Screen”. Until then, use “Calendar reminder” on any pop-up page.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Allow them in site settings, or use “Calendar reminder”.
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. Use “Calendar reminder” on any pop-up page.
notifications.savedPromptBody: We'll remind you a day before one of your saved pop-ups ends.
notifications.pushBody: You saved this pop-up. Tap for details and directions.
